messages:
maria chen: Heads up — I'm opening a docs PR to add Japan (ap-northeast-1) residency note and update SDK samples with region header.
samir patel: thanks! could you link the new endpoints table?
maria chen: done — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/827
kevin lee: quick ask: wording on 'data residency' needs legal sign-off. pinging @legal-team
legal-team: we can approve but need to add 'subject to export controls' clause. I'll drop a suggested sentence.
olivia_ng: also double-check the python snippet — there's a typo in the header name (Region vs region)
maria chen: good catch. current snippet:
```python
client = Redwood(api_key=...)
client.generate("Hello", headers={"X-Redwood-Region":"ap-northeast-1"})
```
samir patel: I'd prefer using endpoint subdomain example to avoid header confusion: `https://ap.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
maria chen: added both examples and left a note: "If using Private, prefer header over public endpoint for internal routing." — needs tech review
kevin lee: LGTM except the footnote link; the existing anchor points to a deprecated legal page. I'll paste correct link.
kevin lee: https://legal.redwood.ai/data-residency
maria chen: updated PR to use that link. Also added a small migration guide section for customers moving from global endpoints to region-specific endpoints.
olivia_ng: can someone run the SDK snippet tests? I don't want broken examples in the docs.
samir patel: running quick check now — will paste failing logs
samir patel: failing on node example: the npm package name is `@redwood/sdk` not `redwood-sdk`
maria chen: fixed package name and pushed commit
docs-bot: build docs preview: success — http://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/827
maria chen: awesome, I think we're nearly done. @legal-team please confirm final phrasing
legal-team: approved with minor edit, see comment in PR
maria chen: merging after CI green. thanks everyone :rocket:
kevin lee: can we add a short note in the changelog about APAC addition and residency caveats?
maria chen: added entry under 2026-03-20
olivia_ng: nice, closing this thread — will follow-up if any customer asks :+1:
